note: Extract of the French repairability index (indice de réparabilité). National French score, not an EU repairability score.
title: Dishwashers ranked by the French repairability index
scale: 0 to 10 (indice de réparabilité, Code de l'environnement, Art. L. 541-9-2)
method: Sorted by the score as published by the company that placed the model on the French market. No own rating. Ranks are consecutive (1, 2, 3); with equal scores, the longer spare parts supply (upper bound of years) comes first, then the name. One row per model (entries with the same model name or the same barcode merged, newest entry kept).
criteriaScale: 0 to 20 points each; score = sum / 10 (Code de l'environnement, Art. R. 541-210)
